title: Kimi K3 Weight Officially Launched: The World's First 3 Trillion Open-Source Model, Revolutionizing More Than Just Technical Rankings

content_html:
Moonshot AI has officially uploaded the complete model weights of Kimi K3 to Hugging Face, with the technical report simultaneously published on GitHub. This model, featuring 2.8 trillion parameters, 104 billion activations, and support for a 1 million token context, has become the world's first open-weight model to enter the 3 trillion parameter level - exactly 11 days after it was first released in the form of a managed API on July 16.

Within these 11 days, the story has long gone beyond the technical realm: K3 scored third globally (57 points) in the Artificial Analysis intelligence index, behind only Claude Fable5 and GPT-5.6 Sol; it topped the front-end programming arena Arena with 1679 points; Hong Kong's Z.ai stock plummeted 30% during the day, and MiniMax dropped 16%; Moonshot AI's daily revenue surged by at least six times, and its valuation anchor skyrocketed from 20 billion dollars to 50 billion dollars; the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy Director publicly accused it of distilling Anthropic technology, while the Secretary of the Treasury warned of sanctions.

The license is the real "hidden weapon"

Along with the weights, the Kimi K3 License appears to be under the MIT license, but actually contains hidden commercial rules. The agreement stipulates that any entity providing K3 inference or fine-tuning services to third parties, with annual revenue exceeding 20 million dollars, must sign another agreement with Moonshot AI; commercial products with over 100 million monthly active users or monthly revenue exceeding 20 million dollars must prominently label "Kimi K3" on their interface. This is the first time a leading Chinese model company has explicitly included the practice of "cloud vendors hitchhiking" as a priced commercial clause in an open-source license - those using it purely internally or accessing through official certified inference partners are not subject to these restrictions.

In terms of pricing, the official API price for K3 is 3 dollars per million input tokens and 15 dollars per million output tokens, while Claude Fable5 is 10 dollars per million input tokens and 50 dollars per million output tokens. However, multiple testers have reported that K3 consumes more tokens for the same task, and with the default inference mode enabled, the actual cost advantage per task is not as significant as the pricing table suggests.

content_html_zh:
Moonshot AI已将Kimi K3的完整模型权重正式上传至Hugging Face，技术报告同时发布在GitHub上。 该模型拥有 2.8 万亿个参数、1040 亿次激活，并支持 100 万个代币上下文，成为世界上第一个进入 3 万亿参数级别的开放权重模型——距离 7 月 16 日首次以托管 API 形式发布仅 11 天。

在这11天内，故事早已超出了技术领域：K3在人工智能分析智能指数中获得全球第三（57分），仅次于Claude Fable5和GPT-5.6 Sol；以1679分登顶前端编程竞技场Arena；香港Z.ai股价当天暴跌30%，MiniMax跌16%； Moonshot AI 日营收至少飙升六倍，估值锚点从 200 亿美元暴涨至 500 亿美元；白宫科技政策办公室主任公开指责其提炼人类技术，而财政部长则警告要对其实施制裁。

牌照才是真正的“暗器”

除了权重之外，Kimi K3 许可证看似遵循 MIT 许可证，但实际上包含隐藏的商业规则。 协议规定，任何向第三方提供K3推理或微调服务的实体，年收入超过2000万美元，必须与Moonshot AI签署另一份协议；月活跃用户超过1亿或月收入超过2000万美元的商业产品必须在界面显着位置标注“Kimi K3”。 这是中国领先的模型公司首次明确将“云厂商搭便车”的做法作为有价商业条款纳入开源许可中——纯内部使用或通过官方认证推理合作伙伴访问的用户不受这些限制。

定价方面，K3 的官方 API 价格为每百万输入代币 3 美元，每百万输出代币 15 美元，而 Claude Fable5 为每百万输入代币 10 美元，每百万输出代币 50 美元。 然而，多名测试人员报告称，K3 对于同一任务消耗更多代币，并且在启用默认推理模式的情况下，每个任务的实际成本优势并不像定价表所示的那么显着。
